question: Select the synonym of **Diligent.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Diligent** refers to someone who is hardworking and puts consistent effort into their tasks.
 
• Synonyms are words that have similar meanings, and in this case, **Hardworking** is the closest synonym to **Diligent**.
 
• Other options like **Idle**, **Careless**, and **Indolent** have meanings opposite to that of **Diligent**.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** *The word "Diligent" means showing steady, earnest, and energetic effort, and "Hardworking" is the most appropriate synonym.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Idle** – This means "lazy" or "inactive," which is the opposite of diligent.
 
• **Option 2: Careless** – This means "not paying attention to detail," which contrasts with diligent.
 
• **Option 3: Indolent** – This means "lazy" or "avoiding effort," which is also opposite to diligent.
